context: Tests whether MetricKit telemetry guidance uses the iOS 27 report sequences, durable-first persistence, and an isolated iOS 26 compatibility branch.

checklist.name: Modern manager lifetime
checklist.description: Creates and retains one long-lived MetricManager at app launch for the iOS 27 branch rather than tying it to a view lifecycle.

checklist.name: Both report sequences
checklist.description: Starts exactly one consumer for metricReports and one for diagnosticReports, then fans out after receipt instead of adding competing sequence consumers.

checklist.name: Durable persistence first
checklist.description: Encodes each complete MetricReport and DiagnosticReport and durably enqueues it before parsing, symbolication, upload, or analytics enrichment.

checklist.name: Consumer work stays small
checklist.description: Keeps network upload, retry, and expensive analysis outside the report-consumer loop after durable persistence.

checklist.name: No invented modern backfill
checklist.description: States that the documented MetricManager surface has no pastPayloads or pastDiagnosticPayloads replacement and does not invent an equivalent.

checklist.name: Legacy compatibility branch
checklist.description: Uses an availability-isolated MXMetricManagerSubscriber branch for iOS 26, including legacy pastPayloads and pastDiagnosticPayloads when backfill is required.

checklist.name: Delivery semantics
checklist.description: Distinguishes normally daily metric reports from system-produced individual diagnostic reports and from immediate local Instruments traces.
